system.description:
The Healer discovers the severity and nature of a patient's sickness, though not its cure. This power is believed to date to Saulot's return from the East.

System: The Salubri passes her hands an inch or so above the patient's body, tracing a path from head to foot while concentrating. The player rolls Perception + Medicine (difficulty 7). Each success reveals one detail or symptom of the illness — its kind, likely symptoms, and probable development. Those who have activated Heightened Senses (Touch) beforehand often sense extra heat in the area of the sickness.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
